name: Display Cards: Stack
summary: Three offset cards stacked in depth, with the front card bottom-right. Hover or focus lifts a card forward and the back cards fade into grey.
useWhen: Showing up to three short updates, features or notifications as a stacked preview on a landing page
Highlighting one item at a time in a small space, where each card can be reached with the keyboard
avoidWhen: The items need to be read in full or compared side by side; use bento-grid or a card list instead
There are more than three cards, since the stack hides most of each one
